zh: 建一座净水站，给绿地稳定供水
en: Build a water purifier to give the green patch a stable water supply

zh: 调查奇怪的痕迹（0 / 3）
en: Investigate the strange traces (0 / 3)

zh: 早，{player}。工业区开了，今天能做的事好多！
en: Morning, {player}. The industrial zone is open, there's so much to do today!

zh: 早……门还没开呢，这周一定要打开它
en: Morning… the gate's still not open. We have to get it open this week.

zh: 雨水罐又见底了。绿地那边的苗，叶子都有点黄。
en: The rain tank's empty again. The seedlings over in the green patch are turning a bit yellow.

zh: 工业区里有现成的管子和水泵，我们可以建一座净水站。
en: There are pipes and pumps in the industrial zone we can use. We could build a water purifier.

zh: 净水站：需要 机械 40、生态 40；金属 5、电子元件 3、工作单位 3；需要通电。建好后，用水管把水送到种植区。
en: Water Purifier: requires Mechanics 40, Ecology 40; Metal 5, Electronics 3, 3 work units; requires power. Once built, use water pipes to carry water to the Planting Plot.

zh: 旧电源只够大门用……净水站得先有发电机才行
en: The old power unit's only enough for the gate… We'll need a generator before we can build the purifier.

zh: 仓库：电子元件 −2、金属 −1（原因不明）
en: Storage: Electronics −2, Metal −1 (cause unknown)

zh: 诶？我记得堆了更多的……
en: Huh? I'm sure there was a bigger pile than this…

zh: 支线：调查奇怪的痕迹（1 / 3）
en: Side quest: Investigate the strange traces (1 / 3)

zh: 扫描仪：检测到土壤被翻动，3 株植物缺失
en: Scanner: Disturbed soil detected. 3 plants missing.

zh: 我种的苗……少了好几株。
en: The seedlings I planted… several of them are gone.

zh: 支线：调查奇怪的痕迹（2 / 3）
en: Side quest: Investigate the strange traces (2 / 3)

zh: 扫描仪：检测到未知痕迹
en: Scanner: Unknown traces detected

zh: 这是……一串标记？一直往北边去了。
en: What's this… a trail of markers? It goes all the way north.

zh: 材料、苗，还有这个……这是隐藏任务吧！以前从来没有过！
en: The materials, the seedlings, and now this… It's a hidden quest! There's never been one before!

zh: 支线：调查奇怪的痕迹（3 / 3）· 线索指向：北边
en: Side quest: Investigate the strange traces (3 / 3) · Clues point: North

zh: 扫描仪：未知物品（已损耗）
en: Scanner: Unknown item (worn)

zh: 奖励道具？……坏的。隐藏任务的道具也会坏吗？
en: A reward item? …It's broken. Can hidden quest items even break?

zh: 净水站产水：比预计少 30%（原因不明）
en: Water purifier output: 30% lower than expected (cause unknown)

zh: 电网：检测到不明耗电
en: Power grid: Unidentified power draw detected

zh: 小时候说要找的"稳定的水源"……终于有了。
en: That "stable water source" I wanted to find when I was little… we finally have it.

zh: 目标完成：找到稳定的水源（第 3 周留下的目标）
en: Goal complete: Find a stable water source

zh: 本周还剩 {units} 个工作单位。
en: {units} work units left this week.

zh: 传感器警报：北边厂房检测到未知活动。
en: Sensor alert: Unknown activity detected in the northern factory buildings

zh: 第 5 周结算
en: Week 5 Summary

zh: 标记到这里就没了。
en: The markers end here.

zh: 对面……是温室区。
en: On the other side… that's the greenhouse district.

zh: 通信信号：不稳定
en: Signal: Unstable

zh: 又是信号。上次在大门那里也这样……
en: The signal again. It was like this at the gate last time too…

zh: 桥断了，过不去。可是隐藏任务的终点，一定就在对面！
en: The bridge is broken. We can't get across. But the end of the hidden quest has to be over there!

zh: 下周我们把桥修好，过去看看！
en: Let's fix the bridge next week and go see!

zh: 新区域（未开放）：C 温室与旧居民区
en: New area (locked): C Greenhouse & Old Residential District

zh: 第 6 周
en: Week 6
